title.sl: She said, she told me · Kaj je kdo rekel
title.de: She said, she told me · Was jemand gesagt hat
title.it: She said, she told me · Cosa ha detto
title.en: She said, she told me · What was said

description.sl: say + kaj, tell + komu: She told me ali She said to me, ne *She said me*. Čas gre korak nazaj: She said she was tired. Vprašanje brez do: He asked where I lived.
description.de: say + was, tell + wem: She told me oder She said to me, nicht *She said me*. Die Zeit geht einen Schritt zurück: She said she was tired. Die Frage ohne do: He asked where I lived.
description.it: say + che cosa, tell + a chi: She told me o She said to me, non *She said me*. Il tempo fa un passo indietro: She said she was tired. La domanda senza do: He asked where I lived.
description.en: say + what, tell + who: She told me or She said to me. The tense goes one step back: She said she was tired. A question without do: He asked where I lived.

story.sl: The inn is full of walkers tonight. Mrs Birkett can't hear them all, so you tell her what they said. · Gostilna je nocoj polna pohodnikov. Mrs Birkett ne sliši vseh, zato ji ti poveš, kaj so rekli.
story.de: The inn is full of walkers tonight. Mrs Birkett can't hear them all, so you tell her what they said. · Das Gasthaus ist heute Abend voller Wanderer. Mrs Birkett kann nicht alle hören, also erzählst du ihr, was sie gesagt haben.
story.it: The inn is full of walkers tonight. Mrs Birkett can't hear them all, so you tell her what they said. · Stasera la locanda è piena di escursionisti. Mrs Birkett non riesce a sentirli tutti, così le racconti tu cosa hanno detto.
story.en: The inn is full of walkers tonight. Mrs Birkett can't hear them all, so you tell her what they said.

instruction.de: Pick the right word · Wähle das richtige Wort

exercises.prompt: A walker ___ me she was tired.

explain.sl:
**tell + komu: told me. say brez komu: said, ali said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.** · Rekla mi je, da je utrujena.
- **She said she was tired.** · Rekla je, da je utrujena.
explain.de:
**tell + wem: told me. say ohne wem: said, oder said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.** · Sie hat mir gesagt, dass sie müde ist.
- **She said she was tired.** · Sie hat gesagt, dass sie müde ist.
explain.it:
**tell + a chi: told me. say senza a chi: said, oppure said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.** · Mi ha detto che era stanca.
- **She said she was tired.** · Ha detto che era stanca.
explain.en:
**tell + who: told me. say without who: said, or said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.**
- **She said she was tired.**

exercises.prompt: Jack said he ___ come, but he never turned up.

explain.sl:
**will gre korak nazaj v would, ko je čas že mimo**
- **"I'll come." → He said he would come.** · »Pridem.« → Rekel je, da bo prišel.
explain.de:
**will wird zu would, wenn die Zeit vorbei ist**
- **"I'll come." → He said he would come.** · »Ich komme.« → Er hat gesagt, er würde kommen.
explain.it:
**will diventa would, quando il momento è passato**
- **"I'll come." → He said he would come.** · «Vengo.» → Ha detto che sarebbe venuto.
explain.en:
**will goes one step back to would when the time has passed**
- **"I'll come." → He said he would come.**

exercises.prompt: "Do you want tea?" → She asked ___ I wanted tea.

explain.sl:
**Vprašanje da ali ne: asked if ali asked whether, brez do**
- **She asked if I wanted tea.** · Vprašala je, ali želim čaj.
explain.de:
**Ja-Nein-Frage: asked if oder asked whether, ohne do**
- **She asked if I wanted tea.** · Sie hat gefragt, ob ich Tee möchte.
explain.it:
**Domanda sì o no: asked if o asked whether, senza do**
- **She asked if I wanted tea.** · Ha chiesto se volevo del tè.
explain.en:
**A yes-or-no question: asked if or asked whether, no do**
- **She asked if I wanted tea.**

instruction.sl: Which are right? · Katere so pravilne?
instruction.de: Which are right? · Welche sind richtig?
instruction.it: Which are right? · Quali sono giuste?

options: She told me she was tired.
She said me she was tired.
She said to me that she was tired.
She told to me she was tired.

explain.sl:
**tell vedno s komu, brez to: told me. say brez komu ali s to: said, said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.** · Rekla mi je, da je utrujena.
- **She said she was tired.** · Rekla je, da je utrujena.
explain.de:
**tell immer mit wem, ohne to: told me. say ohne wem oder mit to: said, said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.** · Sie hat mir gesagt, dass sie müde ist.
- **She said she was tired.** · Sie hat gesagt, dass sie müde ist.
explain.it:
**tell sempre con a chi, senza to: told me. say senza a chi o con to: said, said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.** · Mi ha detto che era stanca.
- **She said she was tired.** · Ha detto che era stanca.
explain.en:
**tell always with who, no to: told me. say without who, or with to: said, said to me**
- **She told me she was tired.**
- **She said she was tired.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Mrs Birkett mi je rekla, naj počakam pri vratih.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Mrs Birkett hat mir gesagt, ich soll an der Tür warten.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Mrs Birkett mi ha detto di aspettare alla porta.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: Mrs Birkett told me to wait by the door.

exercises.text: Mrs Birkett told me ___ wait by the door.
accept: to

hint.en: An order: told me + ? + the verb.

explain.sl:
**Naročilo ali prošnja: told me to, asked me to + osnovna oblika**
- **She told me to wait.** · Rekla mi je, naj počakam.
- **She told me not to wait.** · Rekla mi je, naj ne čakam.
explain.de:
**Aufforderung oder Bitte: told me to, asked me to + Grundform**
- **She told me to wait.** · Sie hat mir gesagt, ich soll warten.
- **She told me not to wait.** · Sie hat mir gesagt, ich soll nicht warten.
explain.it:
**Ordine o richiesta: told me to, asked me to + forma base**
- **She told me to wait.** · Mi ha detto di aspettare.
- **She told me not to wait.** · Mi ha detto di non aspettare.
explain.en:
**An order or a request: told me to, asked me to + the base form**
- **She told me to wait.**
- **She told me not to wait.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: V ponedeljek je Jack rekel, da pride naslednji dan.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Am Montag hat Jack gesagt, er würde am nächsten Tag kommen.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Lunedì Jack ha detto che sarebbe venuto il giorno dopo.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: On Monday Jack said he'd come the next day.

exercises.text: "I'll come tomorrow," Jack said on Monday. He said he'd come the ___ day.
accept: next
following

explain.sl:
**Tudi čas se premakne: tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before**
- **He said he'd come the next day.** · Rekel je, da pride naslednji dan.
explain.de:
**Auch die Zeit rückt: tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before**
- **He said he'd come the next day.** · Er hat gesagt, er komme am nächsten Tag.
explain.it:
**Si sposta anche il tempo: tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before**
- **He said he'd come the next day.** · Ha detto che sarebbe venuto il giorno dopo.
explain.en:
**The time words move too: tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before**
- **He said he'd come the next day.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Vprašal me je, ali živim tu.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Er hat mich gefragt, ob ich hier wohne.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Mi ha chiesto se abito qui.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: He asked me if I lived here.

exercises.text: "Do you live here?" → He asked me ___ I lived here.
accept: if
whether

explain.sl:
**Da ali ne: if ali whether, nato vrstni red trditve**
- **He asked me if I lived here.** · Vprašal me je, ali živim tu.
explain.de:
**Ja oder nein: if oder whether, dann die Wortstellung des Aussagesatzes**
- **He asked me if I lived here.** · Er hat mich gefragt, ob ich hier wohne.
explain.it:
**Sì o no: if o whether, poi l'ordine della frase affermativa**
- **He asked me if I lived here.** · Mi ha chiesto se abitavo qui.
explain.en:
**Yes or no: if or whether, then a statement's word order**
- **He asked me if I lived here.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Pohodnica me je vprašala, kdaj pelje avtobus.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Eine Wanderin hat mich gefragt, wann der Bus fährt.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Un'escursionista mi ha chiesto a che ora parte l'autobus.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: A walker asked me what time the bus left.

exercises.text: "What time does the bus leave?" → A walker asked me what time the bus ___ (leave).
accept: left
leaves
would leave

hint.sl: Brez does: kaj ostane od glagola?
hint.de: Ohne does: Was bleibt vom Verb?
hint.it: Senza does: cosa resta del verbo?
hint.en: No does: what is left of the verb?

explain.sl:
**V poročanem vprašanju ni do, does, did; čas gre korak nazaj (ali ostane, če še velja)**
- **She asked what time the bus left.** · Vprašala je, kdaj pelje avtobus.
explain.de:
**In der indirekten Frage kein do, does, did; die Zeit geht einen Schritt zurück (oder bleibt, wenn es noch gilt)**
- **She asked what time the bus left.** · Sie hat gefragt, wann der Bus fährt.
explain.it:
**Nella domanda indiretta niente do, does, did; il tempo fa un passo indietro (o resta, se vale ancora)**
- **She asked what time the bus left.** · Ha chiesto a che ora partiva l'autobus.
explain.en:
**A reported question has no do, does, did; the tense goes one step back (or stays, if it's still so)**
- **She asked what time the bus left.**
